note: Every datatype in the Sanskrit-to-site pipeline: what each transformation of the Sanskrit is FOR, its exact shape, who produces it, what validates it, and the gate rule. A new artifact adheres to the standard iff it validates under its validator AND honors its gate rule. Executable companion: tools/validate_site.py; meta-check in check.py (contract step).

transforms.purpose: Pin the exact Sanskrit under translation. Every downstream claim traces to these bytes.
transforms.gate_rule: No record without source_sha. sha mismatch = BLOCKED.

transforms.purpose: Fast full-verse pass: face every pada quickly so coverage is decided up front, not discovered later.
transforms.gate_rule: Verse count must equal source verse count. quick_english non-empty (mechanical join allowed if marked).

transforms.purpose: The fork record: every meaning a token could bear, with grounds and source. Ambiguity lives HERE, nowhere else.
transforms.validator: schemas/l0.py: fork live|resolved requires >=2 options; resolved requires argmap adjudication; chosen must equal T1 gloss unless revised+reason
transforms.gate_rule: FAILED/0-option tokens block the song. Multi-option tokens without grounds are rejected. Sourceless forks are inventions.

transforms.purpose: The sharp translation's reasoning: argument reconstructed from Sanskrit+T1+L0, adjudications recorded with reasons.
transforms.producer: translator (structured new work; unstructured backfill marked)
transforms.validator: schemas/argmap.py: traces resolve; option_choices.chosen_index == L0 chosen_index; resolved forks must be adjudicated here
transforms.gate_rule: Unstructured allowed only with reconstruction+traces (backfill tier). No adjudication outside option_choices.

transforms.purpose: Plain English of the line. The readable layer; every clause traces to L0.
transforms.validator: schemas/l2.py + proof B7 (cite byte-exact vs source)
transforms.gate_rule: >=1 existing l0_id per verse. Cite must be byte-exact substring of source. supplied[] should log bracketed insertions (backfill TODO).

transforms.purpose: C1: the sharpest poetic reading, canonical. One shared essence list + the STANDARD 7-part essay, preserved. All further renders live in c2-render objects.
transforms.validator: schemas/c1.py: essence non-empty; standard has 7 sections; non-standard keys rejected (moved to C2)
transforms.gate_rule: Standard essay preserved verbatim. No style variants here.
consumers: style renders (withheld from site until essence reviewed)

transforms.purpose: Machine-checkable verdict per song: parse, count, align, cites, sharing, quotes, data-object validity. The envelope sanskritbenchy got right.
transforms.gate_rule: BLOCKED on: parse failure, count mismatch, sub-0.90 without disposition, shared C1/L2 sentences, C1 quotes, cite mismatch, schema errors.

transforms.purpose: What the reader renders. One chunk per verse: Sanskrit always; English ONLY on PASS.
transforms.gate_rule: FAIL-CLOSED: BLOCKED chunks carry zero English. Missing songs absent (greyed, never invented). l1 follows ## chunk (n) + // ref convention.

transforms.purpose: Critical-view argument map per chunk: reconstruction + open points + gloss adjudications.
transforms.validator: validate_site.py (exists per PASS chunk with reconstruction; adjudications match data)
transforms.gate_rule: Prose only; no new claims beyond the argmap object.

transforms.purpose: Bundled offline payload (Bilara-style cognates): chunk + inlined c1/argmap md. Built, never hand-written.
transforms.validator: build-time: source files exist; do not hand-edit dist
transforms.gate_rule: dist/ is generated. Truth lives in site/data/* + translation-work/data/*.

transforms.purpose: Embeddings input: one JSONL line per retrievable unit, gate-labeled so retrieval can filter.
transforms.validator: validate_site.py corpus step: en_gate in closed vocabulary; BLOCKED-en must be labeled (never silently embedded); license present
transforms.gate_rule: RETRIEVER MUST FILTER: chat/style/embeddings may only use en_gate in {PASS,PUBLISHED,OWNER}. BLOCKED/MACHINE_DRAFT English is quarantined by label. Audit: any answer quoting quarantined English is a gate violation.

transforms.purpose: Per-chunk audit trail: claim + evidence + versioned gates. FAIL receipts first-class.
transforms.gate_rule: Every displayed chunk has a receipt, including BLOCKED ones (records what did not pass).

transforms.purpose: Machine-readable argument for reasoning tasks: conclusion + premises + strength + tension links.
transforms.producer: site/build.py build_arguments() (IPVV: from argmaps; stotras: derived from L2 prose — MACHINE_DRAFT)
transforms.gate_rule: All stotra-derived packets are MACHINE_DRAFT until reviewed. Never present as established.

transforms.purpose: Syllable-level audio alignment for recitation: words stay conjoined, timings per syllable.
transforms.validator: build-time: no negative/overlap/multi-lit/stray timings; audio file present
transforms.gate_rule: Timings are performance data, not translation data: never edit translation to fit timings.

transforms.purpose: Prompt-reproducible renders (genz/eli5/poetic/formal/...): a NAME + a PROMPT over the frozen layers. Each render stores its prompt (reproducibility), model/date (provenance), and maps_to (every paragraph points at essence).
transforms.validator: schemas/c2.py via tools/validate_song.py: prompt non-empty; paragraphs non-empty; maps_to valid vs song essence
transforms.gate_rule: Unmapped paragraphs rejected. Renders withheld from site until essence is human-reviewed (T4). A render without its prompt is not reproducible and is rejected.
consumers: future site style views (gated on essence review)

transforms.purpose: Per-word alternative morphology/glosses on the site: tap a word, see what else it could mean and why. OUR glosses+grounds only — witness text never hosted.
transforms.validator: tools/validate_site.py (chunk ids resolve; no witness text leak: options[].source must be controlled vocabulary, grounds <=25 quoted words)
transforms.gate_rule: Variants display for any gate state (they are audit data, not translation claims); fork:live shown as open, fork:resolved shows the adjudication.

transforms.purpose: Human acceptance record: GATE PASS = deterministic green AND human accepted (name+date). Machine proposes, humans dispose.
transforms.validator: schemas/signoff.py via tools/validate_song.py (optional file; invalid signoff blocks)
transforms.gate_rule: Unsigned songs display as machine-proposed. Signed songs carry by/date/scope into site chunks.

worker_contracts.purpose: Worker chat answers grounded in corpus records.
rules: every factual claim cites chunk ids
BLOCKED/MACHINE_DRAFT English must never be quoted as established
user pasted versions (localStorage) are user data, never bundled, never embedded
worker_contracts.validator: worker-side; audit via receipts + corpus labels (not yet enforced in repo — owner-side TODO)

rules: output is UNVALIDATED style transfer: must never enter translations/ or corpus without passing the full gate (T1-L0-argmap-L2-C1-proof)
may be recorded as a C1 render only with maps_to essence indices (same rule as local renders)
worker_contracts.validator: not enforced — stylelab has no gate hook (gap; do not use output as translation)

rules_global: FAIL-CLOSED everywhere: no English without PASS; no render without maps_to; no fork without grounds.
Generated over hand-written: dist/, layers JSON, corpus.jsonl, receipts.jsonl are built. Truth lives in source files.
Provenance on everything: source_sha / immutable_id / model / date travel with the data, not beside it.
Old lane rule stands: translation-work produces site/data inputs; site lane builds and deploys. Handoff logged in process/CLAIMS.md.
